annotations.title: Federal contractors their lenders are marking down

description: BDC-financed federal contractors with a stress signal (a lender marks the first-lien loan below 90% of par, cut it 5+ points in a quarter including Q3 2026 marks as filed, or two managers sit 10+ points apart), largest federal exposure first. Filter by signal (marked_below_90, marked_below_80, lenders_10pt_apart, cut_5pt_q2, cut_5pt_q3, headcount_down_20pct, all_debt_lines_below_90), agency text, state; sort by federal, mark or q3; private_only=true drops names with listed equity or a rated syndicated loan (each row carries market_priced either way). Free: the top 10. full=true: every row with a Tensorust key.

full.description: true returns every row. Needs a Tensorust key (Authorization: Bearer tdk_...).

private_only.description: true: only private contractors with no listed equity and no rated syndicated loan, where BDC marks are the only price
